decisions.reason: The camera builds directly on the firm's long-established star tracker and space optics expertise, so management can read market feedback well and keep improving it in-house.
Successful flight heritage on ESA's HERA mission validates the modular camera platform and strengthens the firm's learning base for follow-on missions.
Space situational awareness is a growing market adjacent to the firm's optical sensor competence, and its own page in both years signals continued commitment.
The LiDAR builds on the firm's rendezvous and docking sensor knowledge, though its lower website prominence suggests a longer development path; cumulative R&D makes keeping it worthwhile.
Radiation-hard imaging is a core extension of the firm's space-qualified camera know-how, and its recent launch with a dedicated page indicates active marketing.

The asteroid navigation camera is closely tied to the HERA heritage, so the firm can assimilate the mission results and apply them to future deep-space bids even though the product is only mentioned on the website.
